source: Mövenpick's MS Sunray fact sheet (2020, its general arrangement labels the suites on deck 4), with RiverCruise.com's matching 5-deck plan for the positions; redrawn by Nilecruz, each deck measured stern 0 to its own bow, deck lengths from the fact sheet's side-by-side plan. Neither image is published.

corrections.note: Mövenpick's fact sheet: '66 spacious and elegantly designed cabins and suites': 60 outside cabins (20 m²), 2 single cabins (15 m²), 2 Junior Suites (37 m²), 2 Senior Suites (39 m²); 72 × 15 m. Its plan puts 8 rooms on deck 1, 22 on deck 2, 28 on deck 3 and 8 on deck 4 (Junior Suites 401–402 and Senior Suites 405–406 among them). Mövenpick's website lists nine bookable room products, including Superior, Deluxe and Executive Suites; those are sales names, not more suites. Correct these in the admin.
cabin_types: CLASSIC Classic Cabin: count 8, deck 1 (the plan's 101–108).
UPPER Upper-deck Cabin: count 52 (60 outside cabins less the 8 Classic), decks 2, 3 and 4; 20 m².
JS Junior Suite: count 2 stays; deck 4, forward (401, 402); 37 m².
SS: rename 'Superior Suite' to 'Senior Suite' (the fact sheet's name for 405 and 406); count 2; deck 4; 39 m².
DS Deluxe Suite and ES Executive Suite: not on the fact sheet, which counts only 4 suites; set inactive unless Mövenpick says otherwise.
Add SGL Single Cabin: count 2, 15 m², 1 guest. The plan doesn't mark which rooms, so it isn't drawn.
Replace 'To be confirmed' as the suites' deck with deck 4.

docs/imports/luxury-vessels.json now says 66 and lists these types, so re-running pnpm import:luxury-vessels sets 66 and adds SGL; it only adds missing cabin types, so the counts, the SS rename and DS/ES must still be edited in the admin.
texts: The summary says '54 cabins and four suite categories': say 66 cabins and suites, with Junior and Senior Suites.
